title: AI‑First 多云时代：从AWS、Google到Azure的技术突破与监管新风险
core_insight: AI驱动的多云协同与合规挑战成为云计算格局的核心结构性转变。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出Amazon ECS Gateway，实现全托管容器入口；Google Cloud发布Cross‑Cloud Interconnect，简化与Azure的多云连接，提升跨云容器与无服务器工作负载的可移植性。Azure推出Cobalt 200系列VM，专为Agentic AI和多模态工作负载设计，配合Azure Catalyst AI基础设施和Microsoft Foundry的持续改进框架，形成从模型、硅片到云平台的全链路协同；Cloudflare开放Kitesurf浏览器引擎并发布AI代理可视化与控制机制，提升边缘AI能力。 AWS发布Continuum代码漏洞自动修复、GPT‑6.1 Terra大模型以及支持Apache Iceberg的Amazon S3 Tables；Google Cloud推出面向AI加速器的专用存储层，显著提升大模型训练与推理的I/O效率。Microsoft IQ作为企业情境管理平台，提供统一的AI代理知识库；Cloudflare引入Spend Management，对Workers等无服务器产品实施细粒度计费，提升资源治理。 Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Lambda Web Functions, Amazon S3 on the Vercel Marketplace, and more AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Simplifying multicloud networking to Azure with partner Cross-Cloud Interconnect Beyond the compute bottleneck: Maximizing the ROI of AI accelerators with purpose-built storage Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era Continuous improvement comes to Microsoft Foundry
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Azure未公布新区域，但Cobalt 200 VM在现有区域全线开放；Cloudflare推出Spend Management，为无服务器产品提供可选消费上限，提升企业成本可控性。 Nvidia发布面向HPC的Rubin GPU，提供更高算力，标志AI/高性能计算芯片进入新一代迭代；Cobalt 200系列提供更高的GPU/CPU比率和能效，针对Agentic AI工作负载优化；Volcengine发布ByteHouse云数仓版和DataLeap大数据治理套件，补强中国市场的数据基础设施供给。 GPU giants throw HPC users some tasty crumbs America's hyperscale bit barns draw as much power as entire states Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵 Introducing Spend Management: Spending limits and alerts for Cloudflare
